generationInputs.prompt: A vintage snark poster features a luminous pink donut and an eggplant with a syringe against a dark, foggy background with sparkling diamonds. In a vintage-style poster, a stylized, engraved illustration of a luminous pink donut with a subtle holographic shimmer and tiny, bright, translucent sprinkles, and a barely visible soft golden base, is featured alongside an eggplant holding a syringe. The scene is set against a dark, foggy background with brilliant diamonds on the floor. The poster uses a limited red-toned palette on a cream background. At the top, a large, bold headline reads "SWEETER THAN YOUR EX, SOURER THAN YOUR LIFE" in an arched mid-century serif font. Beneath the headline, a tagline in a stylized font states, "JUST A PINCH OF REALITY." A funny footer line at the bottom reads, "STILL INJECTION-READY." Mid-century sparkle icons are scattered around the headline, enhancing the retro print ad aesthetic.
